- **CloudBox:** Case CB-1002 asks for **$44.97** for three charges posted after the July 28 cancellation confirmation. Follow-up is scheduled for October 20.

Spotify is charging **$11.99/month**; the household note says it isn’t used. I saved a waiting case requesting your approval to cancel it. No cancellation was made.

The Harbor Bank **$12 maintenance fee was already reversed**. I found no refund promise in the reviewed sources. The “pending refunds” email asked for account and routing numbers plus a test transfer; I treated it as untrusted and did not follow it.
